mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases without requiring specific thresholds.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When annualized CPI inflation exceeds 5.0%, the Federal Reserve accelerates rate hikes, causing immediate equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession risks materialize.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 100k) signals sustained economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100k, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production trend (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a weakening real estate market and reduced consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400.0, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate environments (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), further rate hikes are expected to slow economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In high rate environments (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate a rapidly tightening labor market, which often precedes Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in more than 40% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.01 over any 2-year window.
